description: Guren agent harness: run `guren gate` when a turn ends with uncommitted changes. The command looks for the app's .codex/ upward from the session cwd, which may be a subdirectory of the app.

hooks.command: d="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$d/.codex/hooks/gate-on-stop.ts" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; bun "$d/.codex/hooks/gate-on-stop.ts"
